attributes.title: "Across the Water": Empowering School Nurses for Healthier Students
attributes.organizer: Maryland Association of School Health Nurses
attributes.summary:
The Maryland Association of School Health Nurses meets on Saturday, March 13, 2027, at the Chesapeake Bay Beach Club in Stevensville on Kent Island. Topics include advocacy in school nursing, POTS and related disorders, eating disorders, seizure disorders and juvenile arthritis.

The activity has been submitted to the Maryland Nurses Association, an ANCC-accredited approver, and the event page lists 6.0 contact hours. Registration is open: through February 15, 2027, members pay $210 and non-members $250, rising to $235 and $275 afterwards; nursing students, retirees, LPNs and health assistants pay $135, then $150. Cancellations are refunded minus a $50 fee until February 15. Reduced room rates are listed at the Holiday Inn Express on Kent Island ($119) and at Hyatt Place Kent Narrows ($169, book by February 13).
